choices.why: None of the sofas is mustard velvet, so this warm cognac-caramel sofa is the closest color, and at 193 cm it suits the long right-hand wall better than the smaller loveseat.
A natural woven rattan armchair is the boho rattan seat the user asked for and is light enough to sit by the balcony door.
This kilim-style rug in red, blue and beige brings bold boho pattern and color to the parquet and picks up the blue of the awning.
These tufted kilim lumbar cushions in terracotta and cream echo the rug, one for the sofa and one for the armchair.
Three of these blue patterned ceramic pots, planted, add greenery and repeat the rug's blue on the bookcase and in the corners.
At 43 cm high and 140 cm wide, this warm wood bookcase sits neatly below the back-wall window.
A carved wooden drum table is a classic boho piece and keeps the room feeling crafted and lived-in.
The paper lantern floor lamp gives soft, relaxed light that suits the boho look.
This black-and-cream tasseled throw adds graphic boho texture over the sofa arm.

answer.why: Warm caramel leather, natural rattan and carved wood sit on a colorful kilim rug. Terracotta cushions, blue ceramic planters and tasseled textiles make the room feel lively, layered and lived-in, as the user wanted.
